test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.**

I wanted to ask if you have an/a _____ bank account. Mine has been __**dormant**__ for a year.
solution: The correct answer is **"active."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Dormant" **means not active for some time. (कुछ समय के लिए निष्क्रिय) • **Example**: *Her talent might have lain **dormant**__ had it not been for her aunt's encouragement.* • The antonym of **"dormant"** is **"active."** • **"Active"** means involved in activity; lively. (सक्रिय, क्रियाशील; चुस्‍त, फुरतीला, जीवंत) __ • **Example**: *My grandfather is very **active**__ for his age.* • The sentence implies that the speaker's bank account has not been used for a year. • The correct answer is Option 3. **Correct sentence**:* I wanted to ask if you have an __active__ bank account. Mine has been dormant for a year.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: "Inert" **means lacking in energy or movement. (जड़, स्थिर) • **Option 2: "Side"** means one of the flat outer surfaces of something. (किसी वस्‍तु की कोई एक समतल बाहरी सतह; पार्श्व, फ़लक) • **Option 4: "Quick" **means done with speed; taking or lasting a short time. (फुरती से किया गया; थोड़ा समय लेने या रहने वाला) 3e:T805, The correct answer is **"worth his weight in gold."**
